site.heroSubtext: The best product companies in the world do not own their factories. They hire the best one. Leafcut is that floor for video — 50,000 finished videos, one system, delivered in as little as 24 hours.
site.aboutHeading: A floor built for volume, run like a line, finished like a studio.
site.aboutPara1: Apple does not own a chip factory. It hires the best one on earth — and nobody thinks less of an iPhone for it. Leafcut is that floor for video: the production system that agencies and enterprise brand teams both hire, because we hold quality at a volume and speed they cannot staff for.
site.aboutPara2: Every project runs through the same system: a clear brief, a producer who owns the account, a tight edit, and a final cut checked against your brand before it ships. No bloated timelines, no jargon — just a floor that holds the line at scale.
site.logosSubtext: Plus hundreds of SaaS, fintech, e-commerce, education and media teams across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.
site.studioHeading: A production floor in Kathmandu, running for the world.
site.studioPara1: Leafcut has delivered more than 50,000 finished videos to teams in 22+ countries. We are 30 to 50 people in Kathmandu, Nepal — producers, editors, animators, quality leads and creative directors — running one system built for high output that does not lose quality as it scales.
site.studioPara2: We do not hide where we are. Our location is the reason we can staff a senior floor, run an AI production stack, cover every time zone, and deliver at a fraction of what the same work costs from a studio in London or New York — without touching the craft. Every client works with the same team, on the same system, in their own working hours.
site.testimonialQuote: Leafcut understood our vision from the first call and turned it into something we're proud to put in front of customers. Fast, clear, and genuinely creative.
